visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with thick black pigtails and a fringe walks from a bright kitchen through a sliding door into a hallway. She wears a mustard yellow turtleneck sweater and light-colored leggings. She smiles at the person filming. (2) The girl stands in the hallway with a focused expression and brings her hands together in a traditional 'gongxi' clasping gesture. In the background, a second child in matching clothes crawls on the light-wood floor. An adult's arm enters the frame from the side. (3) The girl receives a long, white rice cracker from the adult. She immediately puts it in her mouth and chews while looking into the lens with big, curious eyes. The lighting is warm and domestic, illuminating the clean home environment. (4) The camera angle shifts to a medium close-up as the girl performs the hand-clasping gesture again while chewing. Behind her, a small white play tent and a lit Christmas tree are visible in a spacious living room. (5) The screen transitions to a solid pink background with a centered cartoon illustration of the girl holding a peach, accompanied by white English text at the bottom.
